title: Cycle-level pullback compatibility for module cup products

from.place: proof step 3: lift the two input classes to kernel cocycles and compare their paired resolution classes

statement: In the setting of module cohomology on schemes, for a morphism f:X\to X\prime, quasi-coherent modules F and G, module cup products cup and cup\prime on X and on the tensor-pullbacks, and a cup-paired acyclic resolution D of F and G, the pullback of cup applied to the classes represented by any two cycles of D equals cup\prime applied to the pulled-back classes, after the canonical tensor-pullback comparison on the target.

proof.text: Use the functorial Godement or acyclic resolution pairing, transport its three complexes through the pullback adjunction unit, and apply the IsModuleCupProduct characterizations to the transported cycles. The sectionwise tensor comparison identifies the transported target pairing with the tensor of the transported input pairings; the resulting equality is exactly the displayed cycle-level formula.
